issues.problem: “锦棠（原文仅作此称……）”/“as the source calls him”是关于完整来源的断言。证据显示传文交代了锦棠的来历：他是松山之兄子，九年接替阵亡的松山。

evidence.quote: 九年，松山陣歿，以其兄子錦棠代之

issues.proposed: 删去括注“原文仅作此称”。中文改为“由松山之侄锦棠（九年接替阵亡的松山统兵）接替”，英文同步改为“Jintang, the nephew of Songshan, whom he had replaced on Songshan's death in battle in the ninth year”。
issues.rationale: 删去“原文仅作此称／as the source calls him”这类关于来源的断言，改据证据交代锦棠是松山之侄，九年松山阵殁后接替松山。中英同步，并在 ev 中补入 E21。

issues.problem: 锦棠在开头首次出现，没有说明他是谁、与本事有什么关系，只用“与金顺并非一人”来辨别。英文 Jintang 与 Jin Shun 字形相近，括注反而加重混淆，读者会以为出现了两三个人。

evidence.quote: 以其兄子錦棠代之
錦棠經布魯特游牧為西路

issues.proposed: 首次出现时说明身份，例如“左宗棠麾下西路统兵、松山之侄锦棠”，并删去与金顺比较的括注。此后全文统一称“锦棠／Jintang”。
issues.rationale: 锦棠首次出现时即说明其身份（松山之侄）及其在本次部署中统西路，删去与金顺比较的括注，全文统一称锦棠／Jintang。

issues.problem: 英文首次出现的引语（"first take the matter up in negotiation..."、"set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage"）是译文，但正文没有任何标示，读者会当作原文。说明直到 limits.0 才出现。story.0–5 的英文引语情况相同。

evidence.quote: 當先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝

issues.problem: 开头连续堆叠“四月、五月、七月、明年正月”等年号月份和多个人名，读者在此处还用不上，冲淡了“僵局如何被打破”这条主线。
issues.proposed: hook.1 只保留“上奏—获嘉许—改约—出屯哈密—和议成”的主线，具体月份移到 story.7–8。不删除任何事实。

issues.problem: context 开头介绍帕夏，却没有先说明他是塞外回酋、据有新疆南北诸城而不受清廷控制。“和硕伯克”“南八城”也没有解释。不了解背景的读者说不清帕夏与清廷、伊犁是什么关系，也说不清为何俄国能借机取伊犁。

edits.after: 僵局之中，以西事自任的左宗棠上奏，逐条点出哪几处不可许，主张「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」。奏上获嘉许，崇厚得罪去，朝廷命曾纪泽使俄改约；他于是自请出屯哈密。六年四月（原文年号纪年），他「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。七月，他奉诏入都备顾问，由锦棠接替。锦棠是松山之侄，九年松山阵殁后接替松山；在左宗棠此番的部署中，他统西路。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁。

edits.before: Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself, with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and the court sent Zeng Jize to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year (by the reign-year count used in the source) he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage," and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the seventh month he was summoned to the capital and Jintang (as the source calls him; a different man from Jin Shun, who led the eastern column), who led the western column, took his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.
edits.after: Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself, with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued — in the history's words, given here in translation, as are all English quotations in this piece — that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and the court sent Zeng Jize to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year (by the reign-year count used in the source) he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage" (in translation), and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the seventh month he was summoned to the capital as an adviser, and Jintang took his place. Jintang was Songshan's nephew, who had replaced Songshan after Songshan died in battle in the ninth year; in Zuo's present deployment he led the western column. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.

edits.before: Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The figure the biography calls the Pasha had originally been a heshuo beg of the Andijan people. He seized Kashgar and gradually encroached on the eight southern cities. He then defeated Tuoming, who held Urumqi, and so took over the northern cities of Ili and collected their revenues. He could command the Muslim population, sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. At that time Russia sent troops, citing repeated Muslim raids on its border as the reason. It drove the raiders out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.
edits.after: Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The figure the biography calls the Pasha was a Muslim chieftain from beyond the frontier, originally a heshuo beg — a local chief — of the Andijan people, who, fearing pressure from Russia, crossed into the frontier region. He seized Kashgar and gradually encroached on the southern cities (the biography's "eight southern cities"). He then defeated Tuoming, who held Urumqi, and so took over the northern cities of Ili and collected their revenues, holding cities both south and north. He could command the Muslim population, sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. The history says that at that time, because Muslim forces repeatedly raided its border, Russia sent troops, drove them out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.

edits.before: As for success and failure, the history records that peace was concluded and Ili returned. Just before that, it says, in a phrase translated here, that "Russia, too, was awed by our military might and feared an outright rupture," but this is merely set alongside the conclusion of peace. It gives no substance for Zeng Jize's revision of the treaty, and it does not attach the outcome to any one man's name. To read this episode as a lesson that the war party was right and the peace party wrong goes beyond what the material can support.

issues.problem: “六年四月……七月……九年松山阵殁”连排，读者会以为“九年”在“六年”之后，和锦棠在六年已统西路矛盾。两个年份其实属于不同的年号纪年，稿件没有区分，造成时序错乱的印象。中英文同样如此。

evidence.quote: 九年，松山陣歿，以其兄子錦棠代之
六年四月，宗棠輿櫬發肅州

issues.proposed: 删去“九年”，改为“锦棠是松山之侄，此前松山阵殁，由他接替”。英文同步改为 "who had earlier replaced Songshan after Songshan died in battle"。

issues.problem: 开头连续堆叠六年四月、五月、七月、九年、明年正月等年份，又插入锦棠、松山的承袭关系。松山第一次出现就没有说明身份，锦棠也只用名字，读者在开头还用不上这些信息，反而分不清人物。

evidence.quote: 松山陣歿，以其兄子錦棠代之
錦棠經布魯特游牧為西路

issues.proposed: hook.1 保留到“自请出屯哈密”和“明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁”。行程月份和锦棠的来历移到 story.6 或 story.8 锦棠首次出现处，写成“锦棠（统兵将领松山之侄，松山阵殁后代领其军）”。中英文同步修改。

issues.problem: “南北诸城都在他手里”超出证据。传文对南路只说“稍蠶食南八城”，北路是“並有北路伊犁諸城”，并未说南北诸城尽归帕夏。英文 "holding cities both south and north" 同样是一句没有必要的概括。

evidence.quote: 據喀什噶爾，稍蠶食南八城
遂並有北路伊犁諸城，收其賦入

issues.proposed: 删去“南北诸城都在他手里”，英文删去 ", holding cities both south and north"。

issues.problem: 伯克胡里、白彦虎第一次出现，没有说明他们与帕夏的关系，读者不明白为什么他们是“叛人”。

evidence.quote: 帕夏飲藥死，其子伯克胡里戕其弟，走喀什噶爾
白彥虎竄處烏城，仍隸帕夏

issues.proposed: 改为“帕夏死后，其子伯克胡里收纳了原隶帕夏、据乌鲁木齐的白彦虎……”，英文同步修改。

issues.problem: “想「欲藉通商深入腹地」”中“想”与“欲”语义重复。
